score_notes.A: Coherent intro -> timeline -> six lineage sections -> cross-cutting -> comparison table -> outlook -> conclusion; every heading is a noun phrase. Deductions: L237 '\beta_{\text{bo$n$}}' puts single '$' signs inside a $$ block (blog math rule: no single $); L799 '### 계보마다 다르게 나타나는 정렬 세금' is one paragraph; the comparison table (L768) sits at the end of the cost-structure section after its own commentary paragraph (L766) rather than heading the comparison.
score_notes.B: Mostly natural '입니다' Korean with English terms on first use. Deductions: figure introductions repeat one template about 20 times ('…그림에서는 … 볼 수 있습니다', L52 '개략도에서는 … 확인하면 됩니다', L211 '그림에서 볼 곳은', L74 '…가 MuJoCo 결과 그림의 요점입니다'); restatement markers 'L722 결국 그룹 안의…', 'L817 결국 바뀐 것은…'; L489 '…모순되지 않는다고 해석할 수 있습니다' is a hedge-on-hedge; English in table cells 'L771 5k offline vs mock', 'vs' throughout; L13 passive '얻어지지 않습니다' -> '얻을 수 없습니다'.
score_notes.C: Running example ties sections together. Deductions: dangling back-references L539 '앞서 본 대로 Chatbot Arena에서도' (Chatbot Arena first appears here), L676 '앞서 언급한 그룹 크기만큼' (group size is never given), L726 '앞서 소개한 통합 그래디언트 식 하나로' (L680 only describes it in prose, no formula); synthesis sections L736-L821 restate cards (SimPO reward hacking L543/L760/L819, ref-free KTO L732/L760/L819, Mistral leaderboard decline L618/L762/L801, Online IPO summary-only L581/L640/L762/L807).
score_notes.D: Strong: each mechanism gets a numeric worked example on the email pair (L70 BT loss 0.13, L108 KL penalty, L329 DPO loss 0.555, L371 IPO target, L459 RRHF, L495 ORPO, L533 SimPO length normalization, L608 SPPO, L722 GRPO advantages), hypothetical values labelled '가상의'. Minor padding: long figure tours for routine plots (L138, L229, L610).
score_notes.E: Equations are the papers' own and placed where discussed; no 'Figure N' references. Deductions: 42 figures is decorative overload (several plots added only to be described, e.g. L86-L90 backflip frames, L281-L285); comparison table omits 4 of 22 plan papers (Llama 2, Online IPO, DAA Overoptimization, GRPO Dynamics) and has bad cells (L772 '정량 수치 없음', L774 '-', L780 the same value written twice, L770 a setting instead of a result).
score_notes.F: Of 15 sampled claims 2 are wrong and 1 unsupported. Wrong: L762 'GRPO의 정답 기반 그룹 어드밴티지' and L817 'GRPO는 … 정답 여부를 그룹 안에서 정규화했지만' (DeepSeekMath: 'A reward model is then used to score the outputs'; the post's own L686 says the reward model is retrained); L772 table cell 'Learning to Summarize | 정량 수치 없음' (the paper reports many quantitative results). Unsupported scope drop: L801 'HH-RLHF는 정렬 학습이 거의 모든 NLP 평가를 개선' leaves out the paper's 'Smaller models experience severe alignment taxes', and that omission matters for the post's 'evidence is mixed' argument.

claim_headings.evidence: All H2/H3 are claim noun phrases, e.g. L303 '분배함수가 상쇄되면서 사라지는 보상 모델', L425 '보상 모델 없이도 반복되는 혹 모양 과최적화'; no 다-form headings.

running_example.evidence: Email-refusal pair (y_w, y_l) introduced L15 and reused in every lineage (L70, L108, L166, L199, L277, L329, L371, L397, L459, L495, L533, L555, L579, L608, L636, L662, L722, L795, L817).

facts_said_once.evidence: Card numbers repeated in the table (L124 vs L771, L692 vs L783, L343 vs L778); limitations re-told in synthesis (SimPO reward hacking L543/L760/L819; ref-free KTO L732/L760/L819; RRHF GPU L461/L754; Online IPO summary-only L581/L640/L762/L807).

numbers_with_scope.evidence: Most numbers carry model/setting (L616 'Mistral-7B-SPPO Iter3 … AlpacaEval 2.0'); but L539 adds a hedge that the max's model/setting is unknown, and L801 drops the small-model scope.

nothing_invented.evidence: Hypothetical examples are labelled ('예를 들어 가상의', L277 '이 대입은 설명을 위해 만든 것'); but GRPO reward is misattributed as answer-based (L762, L817) and the L772 cell claims no numbers.

writer_assessment_at_end.evidence: L811 '다음 진전이 손실 함수의 새 형태에서 나올 가능성은 낮습니다', L821 '무엇을 기준점으로 삼고, 그 기준점을 얼마나 자주 갱신하는가'.

length_fitted.evidence: About 70.7k non-space characters and 42 figures; L708-L821 (five synthesis sections) mostly restate the cards.

type_specific_shape.evidence: Has timeline (L21), lineage sections, cross-cutting, comparison table (L768) and outlook; but the survey rule that the table owns the numbers is broken (paper cards carry all the numbers the table repeats), and 4 plan papers are missing from the table.

korean_style.evidence: Consistent '입니다' register and Korean headings; repeated figure-intro template (~20 times), '결국' restatements (4), English 'vs' in table cells.

length.verdict: Too long: five synthesis sections (L708-L821) mostly restate the cards, and 42 figures are more than the argument needs.

top_issues: GRPO reward misattributed as answer/correctness-based (L762 '정답 기반 그룹 어드밴티지', L817 '정답 여부를 그룹 안에서 정규화'); DeepSeekMath scores outputs with a trained reward model, as the post's own L686 says.

Comparison-table quality: L772 '정량 수치 없음' is false, L774 '-', L780 duplicate value, L770 a setting instead of a result, L786 garbled setting; 4 plan papers (Llama 2, Online IPO, DAA, GRPO Dynamics) are missing.

Survey shape broken: numbers live in the paper cards and the table only repeats them, and the synthesis sections re-tell card limitations (SimPO reward hacking 3 times, ref-free KTO 3 times, Online IPO summary-only 4 times). The post is about 70.7k non-space characters with 42 figures.
Dangling back-references and leaked notes: L539 '앞서 본 대로 Chatbot Arena', L676 '앞서 언급한 그룹 크기', L726 '앞서 소개한 통합 그래디언트 식'; L539 '…이 수치만으로 특정되지 않습니다'.

Scope drop and markup: L801 cites HH-RLHF's 'almost all NLP evaluations improve' without its 'smaller models experience severe alignment taxes'; L237 has single '$' inside a $$ block ('\text{bo$n$}'); about 20 repeated figure-intro templates.
